verdict.rationale: The evidence documents Perplexity only in the MCP server role: its MCP Server and Computer MCP server let other clients call Perplexity, which is the opposite direction from this story. Nothing shows users adding their own MCP servers to Perplexity so it can use their tools. The 400+ service managed connector framework is an adjacent feature, not MCP client support, so it earns no credit. Since an AI assistant could plausibly act as an MCP client, the story applies, and the lack of evidence makes the verdict none.
